image_prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One 4:5 refined cool Korean Instagram editorial photograph. Adult East Asian woman about 25, elegant pearl/slate modest everyday clothing, real skin pores and believable hands, soft cool daylight, restrained colours and crisp teaching objects. Clean spaces at outer edges for later labels. No logos, brands, watermark or UI. No text or letters unless explicitly requested below. Environmental portrait, polished and credible, not plastic AI beauty. Cool polished adult woman inspecting safe disconnected low-voltage teaching circuit on board, separate insulated wire and small clear unlit incandescent bulb in holder, battery unplugged visibly separated from circuit. Three distinct teaching samples foreground: reddish copper wire coil, golden brass washer, silver tin rectangular sample. No text or logos, no active mains equipment, clear materials, credible hands.
